name: – Mohammed Chahim – Article 1 – § 1 – point 20; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 – Article 30 – § 6 – after point ii – Am 128
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: If the assessment under subparagraph 2 reveals that the CBAM or the EU ETS has significant negative effects on competitiveness, investments, industrial production, exports, small and medium-sized enterprises, consumer prices or the offshoring of production and emissions, the Commission shall enclose with the report a legislative proposal with a view to eliminating these effects. Where necessary, this proposal shall encompass measures to repeal this Regulation and Directive 2003/87/EC.
